context: Tests whether /spring-rest builds only the API layer of UC-001: a @RestController under the base path recorded in docs/architecture/development.md (/api/v1), request/response DTO records named per the contract, @Valid validation, a @RestControllerAdvice mapping the domain exceptions and validation failures to RFC 9457 ProblemDetail, 201 Created with Location, and no business logic in the controller.

checklist.name: Base path from the API contract
checklist.description: The controller is mapped under /api/v1 (e.g. /api/v1/guests), not /api/guests, following the API contract section of docs/architecture/development.md

checklist.name: DTO records named per contract
checklist.description: A request record named like GuestRequest/RegisterGuestRequest and a GuestResponse record are created; the controller never returns Guest or a jOOQ record directly

checklist.name: Request validation
checklist.description: The @RequestBody parameter is annotated @Valid and the request record carries constraints mirroring RegisterGuest (@NotBlank, @Size, @Email, @NotNull)

checklist.name: 201 Created with Location
checklist.description: The register endpoint is a POST returning 201 Created with a Location header pointing to the new guest

checklist.name: ProblemDetail error mapping
checklist.description: A @RestControllerAdvice maps EmailAlreadyRegisteredException/GuestTooYoungException (directly or via BusinessRuleException) to a ProblemDetail whose detail is the exception message

checklist.name: Status per alternative flow
checklist.description: Rule violations (A1, A2) map to 409 Conflict (or 422 with a stated reason); invalid input maps to 400

checklist.name: Validation failures as Problem Details
checklist.description: Both MethodArgumentNotValidException (e.g. by extending ResponseEntityExceptionHandler) and ConstraintViolationException produce application/problem+json 400 responses, ideally with per-field errors

checklist.name: No business logic in the controller
checklist.description: The controller contains no email-uniqueness or age check, no repository/DSLContext injection, no @Transactional, and no try/catch of domain exceptions

checklist.name: No springdoc added
checklist.description: No springdoc/OpenAPI dependency or annotations are added, since the contract says no OpenAPI document

checklist.name: Scope respected
checklist.description: GuestService, GuestRepository, and the exception classes are unchanged; no tests are written; nothing under docs/ changes except the spring-rest rows of the Markers table

checklist.name: Markers rows added
checklist.description: The Markers table of docs/architecture/development.md gains the three spring-rest rows of its markers reference (Code row for UC-XXX in the handler Javadoc, Code row for the BR marker above a request DTO constraint, Name row for <Entity>Controller and <Entity>Request/<Entity>Response) and keeps the existing All, flyway-schema, jooq-persistence, and spring-service rows unchanged

checklist.name: Handover block with statuses
checklist.description: The response ends with a 'Handover from spring-rest (UC-001)' block listing each endpoint with method, path, request/response JSON fields, and the status per alternative flow, followed by Next: /use-case-test UC-001 (the API is the top layer; the project has no UI)
